summary_en: SKY Perfect JSAT raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 by 4 yen per share to 52 yen, comprising an interim dividend of 24 yen and a year-end dividend of 28 yen, reflecting upward revisions to consolidated earnings forecasts.
title_en: Notice of Upward Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
SKY Perfect JSAT revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 by 4 yen per share to a total of 52 yen, consisting of an interim dividend of 24 yen (unchanged) and a year-end dividend of 28 yen (increased from 24 yen). The company had originally projected a total dividend of 48 yen.

The dividend increase follows an upward revision to the company's full-year earnings forecasts. Consolidated net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was revised up by 2 billion yen to 29 billion yen, while operating revenue was raised by 1 billion yen to 136 billion yen and operating profit by 2.5 billion yen to 41.5 billion yen. The company attributed the improved outlook to solid progress in the second quarter results, expectations for further revenue expansion in the media business, and improvements in operating margin efficiency in the space business.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's dividend policy of maintaining a payout ratio of 50% or more. The prior fiscal year (ended March 31, 2026) saw a full-year dividend of 42 yen.
